name: moyu
description: A novel reader in the session: plain-text prose, shared annotations, a boss key.

libraryRoot.title: Library root
libraryRoot.description: Directory the novel pane may open. Relative paths resolve from the working directory; .txt, .md and .text files only, and nothing outside it.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: auto follows your own session colours; mono, paper or ink set a preset while the pane is shown.

autoHideSeconds.title: Auto-hide
autoHideSeconds.description: Hide the pane after this many seconds without a key or turn. 0 keeps it open.

snapshotMaxChars.title: Read cap
snapshotMaxChars.description: Hard cap on the text one novel_read hands the model.
